account: Inspection of the posterior state shows all four investigations from action:001 failed before producing any evidence (UnexpectedModelBehavior: Exceeded maximum output retries (2); zero claims, sufficiency=blocked). The only unanswered questions are D8 and D10, which depend on D1-D7/D9 and cannot start. The failure mode is output overruns, so I re-issue the same four genuinely independent threads (each rests only on stable definitions SC1-SC6 and re-derives its own lemmas) with tightened acceptance conditions, explicit brevity directives, and sharper proof-route guidance (e.g., a cleaner descent argument: d' >= d forces 2ab <= 3, hence a=b=1, d <= 3c/2, then c=1 and the root) to shorten search and output. D4+D6 stay coupled (same per-edge growth engine); D5 (constructive lower bounds) and D7/D9 (bounded hand enumeration) remain independent of the structural proof and of each other. D8/D10 are deferred to the remaining steps after evidence lands.
